services.desc: Enjoy days out on the water! Want to rent for more than 7 days? Call us to book! About With a guest capacity of 6, the Angler 20’ center console has a great layout for a variety of water activities including day trips, fishing, and fun on the water. With a 150 hp outboard engine, the boat has sufficient power for your safety and enjoyment. Features include a fixed t-top, rod holders, stowage compartments, live-well, life jackets, and safety equipment. More Info Security deposit of $1,000 charged first day of rental.
